facts.name: ledger_read
facts.text: Ledger: cans went missing on the third, seventh and eleventh nights. Pell was on duty each time.

facts.name: gate_checked
facts.text: Gate log: Corporal Vance signed out late on the third, seventh and eleventh nights, alone, with an empty truck bed.

facts.name: saw_swap
facts.text: Fuel shed: Vance asked Pell to swap shifts tonight. Pell agreed without looking up. Vance has a scar across his chin.

facts.name: knows_scar

facts.name: found_seals

facts.name: saw_handoff

facts.name: saw_hooks
facts.text: By the hooks, through the smoke glass: the soldier marks each hung rifle by its stock stamp, wheel or hook, and by the hand that hung it.

facts.name: asked_drinkers
facts.text: Green Pit tables: a Kiln rider says the soldier asks nothing and only counts. A Yard welder says he counted her crew too.

facts.name: read_tally
facts.text: His sheet: a column of faces and stamps. Yard crews sit beside Kiln riders on every line.

facts.name: saw_drop
facts.text: Silver's post, inside the Yard: a clerk pins the sheet by the captain's door and inks a line under it. Yard crews drink with raiders.
